text: Hi everyone, my boyfriend and I are in the process of applying for a partnership visa for me. I have been here on a student visa since 2022 and now that my master's degree is almost over we are submitting the partnership visa application. We submitted the online application with all the documentation and got a response back that it is not possible for us to submit the application now because I'm on a student visa. They stated that we have to either close the file and resubmit at a later date, or switch me to a tourist visa to then continue the application. Has anyone been in a similar situation and can offer advice?
